verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own pages link to online versions of core corporate transactions: 'Register a Foreign (Non-WA) LLC Online', 'Close a Corporation Online', and an 'Express Annual Report' filing path, alongside 'Start a Domestic (WA) Business'. That shows founders can complete the core register and file transactions online. The evidence is mostly link titles with no detail on the end-to-end flow, and the DOR business-license items belong to a separate agency. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that domestic entity formation itself is completed and paid online, documentation of the online filing and payment workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
